verified_fact: Matsya (fish) is the first of Vishnu's ten avatars (Dashavatara). Vishnu took this form to save the Vedas stolen by demon Hayagriva and to help sage Manu survive the great flood, similar to Noah's Ark narratives across cultures.
voiceover_script: Vishnu ka pehla avatar — ek machli! Raja Satyavrata ke haath ek chhoti machli aayi. Machli boli — mujhe bada hone do, mahapralaya aane wali hai. Dhheere dheere machli itni badi hui ki saath le gayi samandar mein! Mahapralaya aayi. Manu ki naav ko Matsya ne apni seeng se kheencha — Vedas, sapt-rishiyon ko bachaya. Pralaya ke baad naya sansaar shuru. Kya Noah ki story aur ye story ek hi hai?
debate_question: Matsya avatar aur Noah ki kahani — ek hi source hai kya?

Matsya Avatar: Machli Bani Bhagwaan! 🐟

🔱 Vishnu Matsya avatar fish saves Vedas great flood Manu

Matsya (fish) is the first of Vishnu's ten avatars (Dashavatara). Vishnu took this form to save the Vedas stolen by demon Hayagriva and to help sage Manu survive the great flood, similar to Noah's Ark narratives across cultures.
